Though the greatest number of Huguenots banished from France at the Revocation of the Edict of Nantes were merchants and manufacturers, who transferred their skill and arts to England, which was not then a manufacturing country; a large number of nobles and gentry emigrated to this and other countries, leaving their possessions to be confiscated by the French king.

arxiv-2107-09902.title: On the Generalized Covering Radii of Reed-Muller Codes
arxiv-2107-09902.creator: Dor Elimelech, Hengjia Wei, Moshe Schwartz
arxiv-2107-09902.description: Abstract We study generalized covering radii, a fundamental property of linear codes that characterizes the trade-off between storage, latency, and access in linear data-query protocols such as PIR. We prove lower and upper bounds on the generalized covering radii of Reed-Muller codes, as well as finding their exact value in certain extreme cases.

arxiv-2204-03603.title: Algebraic Structure of the Weak Stage Order Conditions for Runge-Kutta Methods
arxiv-2204-03603.creator: Abhijit Biswas, David Ketcheson, Benjamin Seibold, David Shirokoff
arxiv-2204-03603.description: Abstract . Runge-Kutta (RK) methods may exhibit order reduction when applied to stiff problems. For linear problems with time-independent operators, order reduction can be avoided if the method satisfies certain weak stage order (WSO) conditions, which are less restrictive than traditional stage order conditions.

arxiv-2205-10862.title: Localization and observers in ϱ \varrho -Minkowski spacetime
arxiv-2205-10862.creator: Fedele Lizzi, Luca Scala, Patrizia Vitale
arxiv-2205-10862.description: Abstract We consider the ϱ \varrho -Minkowski spacetime, a model with linear noncommutativity involving the time and the azimuthal angle. We study its quantum symmetries, the ϱ \varrho -Poincaré quantum group, and analyze the concepts of localizability and quantum observers.

arxiv-2206-10515.title: Root- 𝑻 ​ 𝑻 ¯ {{T\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muT\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu}} Deformations in Two-Dimensional Quantum Field Theories
arxiv-2206-10515.creator: Christian Ferko, Alessandro Sfondrini, Liam Smith, Gabriele Tartaglino-Mazzucchelli
arxiv-2206-10515.description: Abstract In this letter we introduce a one-parameter deformation of two-dimensional quantum field theories generated by a non-analytic operator which we call Root- T ​ T ¯ T\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muT\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu . For a conformal field theory, the operator coincides with the square-root of the T ​ T ¯ T\mkern 1.5mu\overline{\mkern-1.5muT\mkern-1.5mu}\mkern 1.5mu operator.

arxiv-2207-02720.title: Rheology of Polydisperse non-Spherical Graphite Particles Suspended in Mineral Oil
arxiv-2207-02720.creator: Th. Larsen, A. L. Søbye, J. R. Royer, W. C. K. Poon, T. Larsen, S. J. Andreasen, A. D. Drozdov, J. D. C. Christiansen
arxiv-2207-02720.description: Abstract We study the role of filler concentration and microphysics on the rheology of polydisperse flake-graphite particles suspended in Newtonian mineral oil. Under steady shear, our samples exhibit shear thinning and yielding behaviour is observed for volume fractions ϕ > 0.18 \phi>0.18 .

arxiv-2207-09549.title: The fate of topological frustration in quantum spin ladders and generalizations
arxiv-2207-09549.creator: Po-Wei Lo, Michael J Lawler
arxiv-2207-09549.description: Abstract Topological frustration (or topological mechanics) is the existence of classical zero modes that are robust to many but not all distortions of the Hamiltonian. It arises naturally from locality in systems whose interactions form a set of constraints such as in geometrically frustrated magnets and balls and springs metamaterials.

arxiv-2404-07119.title: Open reaction-diffusion systems: bridging probabilistic theory and simulations across scales
arxiv-2404-07119.creator: Mauricio J. del Razo, Margarita Kostré
arxiv-2404-07119.description: Abstract Reaction-diffusion processes are the foundational model for a diverse range of complex systems, ranging from biochemical reactions to social agent-based phenomena. The underlying dynamics of these systems occur at the individual particle/agent level, and in realistic applications, they often display interaction with their environment through energy or material exchange with a reservoir.

arxiv-2406-11954.title: Spatial and Spectral Characterization of the Gravitational-wave Background with the PTA Optimal Statistic
arxiv-2406-11954.creator: Kyle A. Gersbach, Stephen R. Taylor, Patrick M. Meyers, Joseph D. Romano
arxiv-2406-11954.description: Abstract Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have made tremendous progress and are now showing strong evidence for the gravitational-wave background (GWB). Further probing the origin and characteristics of the GWB will require more generalized analysis techniques. Bayesian methods are most often used but can be computationally expensive.

arxiv-2408-04147.title: The short exact sequence in definable Galois cohomology
arxiv-2408-04147.creator: David Meretzky

arxiv-2507-00664.title: Microscopic pairing in fission dynamics
arxiv-2507-00664.creator: A. Zdeb, A. Baran, S.A. Giuliani, L.M. Robledo, M. Warda
arxiv-2507-00664.description: Abstract Nuclear fission can be modelled as a quantum tunneling process driven by the interplay between the nuclear binding energy and the collective inertia. Within the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin formalism, spontaneous fission half-lives can be obtained by minimizing the action integral in the multidimensional space of collective degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2602-05513.title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
arxiv-2602-05513.creator: Xukun Li, Yu Sun, Lei Zhang, Bosheng Huang, Yibo Peng, Yuan Meng, Haojun Jiang, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Alois Knoll, Zhenshan Bing, Xinlong Wang, Zhenguo Sun
arxiv-2602-05513.description: Abstract Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on integrating multimodal inputs to perform complex real-world tasks. To address the challenges of effectively combining these modalities, we propose DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that disentangles vision, proprioception, and tactile signals through specialized conditioning pathways, enabling structured and controllable integration of multimodal inputs, with a lightweight adapter for parameter-efficient injection of additional signals.

pmc-10718389.title: Efficacy of sexual intercosurse in the spontaneous passage of distal or intramural ureteral stones: a randomsized controlled trial
pmc-10718389.creator: Kamran Hassan Bhatti, Rawa Bapir, Waseem Sarwar Bhatti, Huda Muhaddien Muhammad, Hiwa O. Abdullah, Berun Anwar Abdalla, Aftab Ahmed Channa, Hawbash M. Rahim, Naeem Ahmed Cheema, Nadeem Sohail, Faaz S. Gomha, Fattah H. Fattah, Nahidah Hamah Ameen Ahmed, Ismael Aghaways, Fahmi H. Kakamad
pmc-10718389.description: Background:The role of sexual intercourse as an alternative treatment approach for ureteral stones (UTSs) is a recent area of investigation with only small sample-sized studies. This study aims to evaluate the role of sexual intercourse in the spontaneous passage of distal or intramural UTSs via a larger sample size.

pmc-11505906.title: Primary Adrenal Insufficiency, Complete Sex Reversal, and Unique Clinical Phenotype in a Patient with Severe CYP11A1 (P450scc) Deficiency—Case Report and Literature Overview
pmc-11505906.creator: Zuzanna Nowak, Ewelina Preizner-Rzucidło, Jakub Gawlik, Jerzy B Starzyk, Dominika Januś, Yohei Ikezumi
pmc-11505906.description: Background: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) is a group of genetic disorders that lead to the dysfunction of the steroidogenesis pathway, resulting in steroid hormone deficiency of varied intensity. The cholesterol side-chain cleavage enzyme (P450scc), coded by the CYP11A1 gene, is vital to the first step in the biosynthesis of steroid hormones, which is the conversion of cholesterol to pregnenolone.

pmc-11614714.title: Deciphering the Prognostic and Therapeutic Value of a Gene Model Associated with Two Aggressive Hepatocellular Carcinoma Phenotypes Using Machine Learning
pmc-11614714.creator: Junhan Pan, Cong Zhang, Huizhen Huang, Yanyan Zhu, Yuhao Zhang, Shuzhen Wu, Yan-Ci Zhao, Feng Chen
pmc-11614714.description: BackgroundMacrotrabecular-massive (MTM) and vessels encapsulating tumor clusters (VETC)-hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) are aggressive histopathological phenotypes with significant prognostic implications. However, the molecular markers associated with MTM-HCC and VETC-HCC and their implications for clinical outcomes and therapeutic strategies remain unclear.MethodsUtilizing the TCGA-LIHC cohort, we employed machine learning techniques to develop a prognostic risk score based on MTM and VETC-related genes.

pmc-11679830.title: Abundance and Distribution of Phlebotomus pedifer (Diptera: Psychodidae) Across Various Habitat Types in Endemic Foci of Cutaneous Leishmaniasis in the Mid-Highlands of Wolaita Zone, Southern Ethiopia
pmc-11679830.creator: Bereket Alemayehu, Temesgen Tomas, Negese Koroto, Teshome Matusala, Aberham Megaze, Herwig Leirs, John Frean
pmc-11679830.description: Phlebotomus pedifer is a vector of Leishmania aethiopica, the causative agent of cutaneous leishmaniasis. This study assessed the abundance and distribution of P. pedifer in different habitats and human houses situated at varying distances from hyrax (reservoir host) dwellings, in Wolaita Zone, southern Ethiopia.

pmc-12657918.title: Synthesis, characterization, computational and biological evaluation of pyrazole hydrazones as promising anti-inflammatory agents
pmc-12657918.creator: Hemant S. Deshmukh, Vishnu A. Adole, A. Alfind Paul Frit, Suraj N. Mali, Haya Khader Ahmad Yasin, Bhausaheb N. Patil, S. Janani, Bapu S. Jagdale

The anti-inflammatory potential was evaluated using the bovine serum albumin denaturation assay, with PMPH and 4F-PMPH showing maximum inhibition at 0.

pmc-12914352.title: Cardiorespiratory rehabilitation program induces additional benefits to hypertension patients: Evidence for improvement of the effort capacity
pmc-12914352.creator: Roxana Cristina Rad Bodan, Eniko Gabriela Papp, Adina Octavia Duşe, Răzvan Marian Melinte, Mindora Andor
pmc-12914352.description: Objectives This study aimed to assess the impact of an eight-week cardiorespiratory rehabilitation program on stabilizing blood pressure values and increasing the patients’ exercise capacity by comparing with other rehabilitation programs, such as hydrotherapy recovery, antihypertensive medication, and recommendations for a healthy life.

pmc-13155295.title: Targeting cGAS-STING signaling to overcome antibiotic-resistant bacterial infections: Challenges and opportunities
pmc-13155295.creator: Yu Seong Ham, Minseo Jeong, Chul-Su Yang
pmc-13155295.description: Increasing antibiotic-resistant bacterial infections pose a global public health challenge that demands therapeutic strategies beyond conventional antibiotics. The cyclic guanosine monophosphate–adenosine monophosphate synthase stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway is crucial to innate immune defense through cytosolic DNA detection and antimicrobial response initiation.

pmc-13415564.title: Market sentiment of electric vehicles in Malaysia
pmc-13415564.creator: Dexin Qiu, Lee Chin, Abdul Rahim Abdul Samad
pmc-13415564.description: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are gaining traction globally due to their potential for energy efficiency and emission reduction. In Malaysia, where the government is actively promoting EV adoption, market sentiment plays a critical role. Most existing studies on EV market sentiment in Malaysia rely heavily on survey-based methods, which may be limited in both scale and objectivity.

pmc-13444283.title: Research on motor diagnosis and maintenance decision-making technology based on DCCNN-L transformer and fault knowledge graph
pmc-13444283.creator: Wu Shufang, Wang Xinwen, Liu Zeyu, Shi Gaoxian
pmc-13444283.description: Traditional deep learning methods for motor fault diagnosis have primarily focused on signal-based classification. Intelligent operation and maintenance encompasses both fault diagnosis and maintenance decision-making. However, transitioning from vibration fault signal diagnosis to generating maintenance decision texts presents challenges such as data heterogeneity between numerical signal data and textual decision data.

pmc-13537912.description: ObjectiveTo demonstrate the feasibility of restoring intelligible, own‐voice speech after total laryngectomy using noninvasive surface electromyography.MethodsOne post‐laryngectomy patient and one healthy reference speaker silently articulated a closed‐vocabulary corpus of 499 dates and times while surface electromyographic (sEMG) signals were recorded from a 20‐electrode face, jaw, and neck montage.
